answer: Like a living reef formed from mineralized trust, agents anchor validation at a decentralized wharf where incoming interactions moor. Each isolated island of identity cannot simply spawn clones to dominate voting; consensus demands cryptographic co-attestation weighted across multi-hop economic history. Creating artificial personas incurs superlinear attacker cost via staked graph percolation: spoofing ten nodes costs a hundredfold in locked capital, starving Sybil swarms before they breach the sanctuary.
